## TemplateEngine.\_processGDiceBlocks() method

Block: g-dice Extracts and parses `<g-dice>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGDiceBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: IDiceBlock;
    };
```

**Returns:**

An object mapping language keys to their dice configurations

## Remarks

Each block declares one dice animation per language (`lang` defaults to `"default"`<!-- -->; last block wins per lang). `emoji` is optional and defaults to `🎲` when absent or empty; the raw attribute string is preserved verbatim (including `{{var|filter}}` spans) for later compilation. Both `<g-dice ...></g-dice>` and self-closing `<g-dice .../>` forms parse identically; the block carries no children. Static emoji membership is enforced by `validateBlockGDiceAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const dice = TemplateEngine._processGDiceBlocks(`<g-dice emoji="{{dice}}"/>`);
// Result: { default: { emoji: '{{dice}}' } }
```
